output.case: Élodie Varnet complains tersely that her kettle has still not arrived eight days after the promised date. The email is two lines long and plainly annoyed.

fields.name: message
fields.value:
Ma bouilloire devait arriver il y a 8 jours et je n’ai toujours rien.
C’est vraiment pénible, merci de me dire où est mon colis.

output.case: Thomas Rivelin politely gives a detailed timeline for a toaster return whose refund remains missing 18 days after receipt was confirmed. He asks when the money will reach his account.

fields.name: message
fields.value:
Bonjour,

Je me permets de vous contacter au sujet du remboursement de ma commande C63091842. J’ai retourné le grille-pain, et votre service m’a confirmé sa bonne réception il y a maintenant 18 jours. Il m’avait alors été indiqué que le remboursement serait effectué rapidement, mais à ce jour, aucun montant n’apparaît encore sur mon compte.

Pourriez-vous, s’il vous plaît, vérifier où en est le traitement de ce retour et me préciser à quelle date le remboursement devrait parvenir sur mon compte bancaire ?

Je vous remercie par avance pour votre aide et reste à votre disposition si vous avez besoin d’informations complémentaires.

Cordialement,
Thomas Rivelin

output.case: Priya Elmsford gives a careful account of a three-month-old kettle that switches on but no longer heats, including the socket and descaling checks she tried. She politely asks whether it can be repaired or replaced under warranty.

fields.name: subject_line
fields.value: Kettle stopped heating after three months

fields.name: message
fields.value:
Hello,

I purchased a kettle from your online shop about three months ago, and it has unfortunately stopped heating. The power light still comes on when I press the switch, but the water remains cold and the kettle does not switch itself off.

I have tried plugging it into a different socket, which works normally with another appliance. I also emptied and descaled the kettle, then allowed it to dry before trying again, but this made no difference. The base and kettle appear to be seated correctly, and there is no visible damage.

Could you please let me know whether the kettle can be repaired or replaced under warranty? My order number is C95410386. I would be happy to provide photographs or any other information you need.

Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,
Priya Elmsford
